# Guide for the Weir

Welcome to the story of the **River Wardens**.

## Naming your file

| You want to say | Add a line like |
| --- | --- |
| A fact it must keep | `pin: River Wardens = green pennant \| "the green pennant" @ The crossing` |

1. Open the file.
2. Click the pencil icon to edit
   the passage where your part begins.
3. Save it.

```
:: Day 2 EV

<script>alert("weir")</script>
[[Go to the weir->The weir]]
```

Raw markup stays text: <script>alert("toll")</script>

See [the naming rules](#naming-your-file) or [the ferry site](https://example.com/ferry).
